name: IRC_DIAG_BKP_ROWS
description: This table stores backup data for diagnostic framework script execution runs.

columns.name: BKP_ROW_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the backup row. System generated value.

columns.name: EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the diagnostic test run.

columns.name: RUN_NAME
columns.description: User name of the diagnostic test run.

columns.name: RUN_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the diagnostic test run.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments for the backup table row.

columns.name: SKID
columns.description: SKID to store the surrogate key of the transaction table row being backed up.

columns.name: XML_DATA
columns.description: XML representation of the table row being backed up in the diagnostic run.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Table name of the transaction table being backed up.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise of the diagnostic test run.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
